card.summary: My own creative planning and mind-map app: endless boards for notes, tables, tasks, widgets and boards inside boards – and a look you can make your own.

props.title: NOTUA
props.meta:
Role: Concept, design & development
Platforms: Web, desktop (Windows), Android
Link: notua.site

props.heading: The most powerful creative planning app
props.text:
NOTUA is a board app I designed and programmed myself. On one endless canvas you collect notes, tables, tasks and widgets, sort them, connect them and turn loose ideas into structured projects – from film scripts and shot lists to mind maps and whole campaigns.

It runs in the browser, as a desktop app and on Android.

props.heading: Everything on one board
props.text: Notes, tables and tasks sit next to images, YouTube videos and Spotify playlists as widgets. Boards can contain boards, so every project gets its own space without losing the big picture.

props.heading: A look that is yours
props.text: The Look Finder lets everyone restyle NOTUA: colour world, light or dark mode, corner radius from sharp to pill, font, shadow, border and board background. The interface is not a fixed product – it adapts to the person using it.
